name: component-cop
shortDescription: DevTools extension that walks a live React fiber tree to flag duplicate components, hardcoded colors, spacing drift and a11y issues.
description:
Component Cop is a Chrome DevTools extension (MV3, also packaged for Firefox) that audits a running React app for UI duplication and inconsistency. It works on both dev and production builds.

Highlights:
- An injected script in the page's main world walks React fiber trees and computed styles; findings flow through a content-script relay to a background worker that stores them in IndexedDB.
- Audits: components grouped by visual similarity with variant diffs, hardcoded and near-duplicate colors, complexity scores, typography, spacing drift across pages, z-index collisions, accessibility (alt text, labels, WCAG AA contrast, touch targets), and design-token compliance.
- An element picker, a multi-page crawler, and baseline snapshots to track whether the codebase is improving.
- Consolidation suggestions with estimated bundle savings; exports to JSON, Markdown, design tokens (CSS / Tailwind / JSON), and an XML format meant for pasting into an LLM.
- A CI report generator with pass/fail thresholds and regression detection.
